text: 中国常驻联合国代表傅聪16日在联大主席召集的“适应未来的地球：以气候行动重建信任”高级别会议上发言，呼吁加强全球气候治理、加快绿色公正转型。发达国家应切实履行气候承诺，多边开发银行、私营部门等应加大气候投融资力度，帮助发展中国家解决资金、技术和能力不足问题。各国应积极开展早期预警、风险评估、防灾减灾等领域国际合作，推动完善应对损失与损害基金快速拨付机制。（新华社）
text_en: China's Permanent Representative to the UN Fu Cong spoke on the 16th at the high-level meeting convened by the President of the UN General Assembly titled "A Future-Fit Planet: Rebuilding Trust with Climate Action," calling for strengthening global climate governance and accelerating a green and just transition. Developed countries should earnestly honor their climate commitments, and multilateral development banks and the private sector should increase climate investment and financing to help developing countries address shortages of funds, technology and capacity. All countries should actively carry out international cooperation in areas such as early warning, risk assessment, and disaster prevention and reduction, and promote the improvement of a rapid disbursement mechanism for the loss and damage fund. (Xinhua News Agency)
